lines.text: My guy! Premium gown. For you, specially.
See? Fine. Don't look down.
Your change? Ah. Take my number instead.
Trust me. It will appreciate.
Welcome to The Plug. I know a guy.
It's a FLAGSHIP locker.
I don't sell products. I sell advantages.
Wear these. Run. You'll understand.
Hajiya, I have a brand.
That is the product.
Refund? In this economy?
Let me give you something better. Advice.
Good afternoon, sir. Table-tennis balls?
(Trust the Plug.)
Torch! Premium torch! Three hundred!
…God, You are watching me.
Take. Take! Don't thank me. I am suffering.
Printed price tags. Air conditioning. God when?
THE PLUG S-T-O-R-E. It's distinctive.
The mall has receipts. We have VOLUME.
Yet. I know a guy. Bring your keke.
It's understood.
Oga Sharp.
One by one! Premium power! For you, specially!
PRE-RICH NO MORE.
Ghost Hoodie. Ten minutes. Security looks past you.
…Free. Don't look at me like that.
If you're caught, you don't know me.
Six kekes. On my credit. I am writing 'charity'.
It is hurting my pen.
Decoy? Me? What does a decoy earn?
…A midnight flash sale. Purely as a business.
THE PLUG STORE MIDNIGHT FLASH SALE!
EVERYTHING MUST GO! INCLUDING ME, IF SECURITY ASKS!
I'm not running. I'm relocating.
I have three sisters. I pay their fees.
My mother thinks the school gives me a grant.
The power banks were two terms. Two terms.
I'm not broke. I'm…
I'm not broke. I'm pre-rich.
And this is a mobile retail platform.
One PREMIUM wheel. Garri, groundnut, sugar. ₦100.
Mama, it is a lifestyle product—
…Can I frame it?
Old stock! I sold a whole carton. Two hundred. Cash!
I sold the locks. For the halls.
…I didn't ask what for. I never ask what for.
Brown. Not brown-brown. Oxblood.
Leather sole. Stitched. A heel that knocks.
I gave him a discount. I gave HIM a discount.
My guy, I was looking at the shoes.
Write my name where it belongs. I sold them.
Premium access! For you, I took only thirty percent.
To *them*. You are the product. Smile.
Free. Don't look at me. It is a sample.
The silence. She had nothing to correct.
I am framing it. Premium.
Real meat. This is a negotiating tactic.
Sir. I have been commercial since I was nine.
This is the first time I am being emotional.
Let me enjoy it.
Thank you for the meat.
Hajiya, what did you write? Let me see.
For you, specially: there is a uniform. And lunch.
Customer is king. Staff must also eat.
No charge! Don't tell my accountant! I AM my accountant!
Chief? In pyjamas? Is that silk? Premium.
Premium noise! For you, specially, free! Sing!
My guy! My first customer! My first investor!
Ah, {{PLAYER_NAME}}! For you, specially: a good morning. Free.
How far? [How are you?] You need anything? You need everything.
Welcome back to the Plug experience.
My person! You don look fresh today. [You look fresh today.]
Oya, talk to me. [Come on.] What are we buying?
Go well. Come back with cash. Or a friend with cash.
Bye! Tell people. Tell everybody. Tell your lecturers.
I dey go. [I'm off.] A customer is crying somewhere.
Thank you! I'll give you a discount. Small. Emotional.
You did that for free? Free? …Thank you. It hurts.
God bless you. And bless your wallet.
Sorry, my guy. Not a refund. A sincere sorry.
Na my fault. [It's my fault.] I'm accepting it. Wholesale.
Look at you! Premium face. Who's your supplier?
That outfit? Correct. You should model for me.
You bargain like Hajiya Ladi. That is a compliment and a threat.
Sunglasses indoors is a lifestyle. You wouldn't understand.
You walk past my stall like it owes you money.
Those slippers have done three convocations, my guy.
Come, come. Walk and talk. Walking is free. Talking is free.
Follow me. I know a shortcut. I also know a guy on the shortcut.
Time is money. You are spending my money.
Abeg, sharp sharp! [Please, quickly!] Market closes.
Not that way! That way has no customers!
Na wrong road be that. [That's the wrong road.] Come back.
Deal!
Yes! For you, specially.
Done. Shake my hand. Firmly. That's a contract.
No. Not even for you. Especially for you.
No-o. I have principles. Small ones, but I have them.
Refund? No. Advice? Yes.
Maybe. Bring the money and we'll see the maybe.
Let me ask my accountant. …I am my accountant. Maybe.
Who? There was nobody there fa. Is he a customer?
Explain it like a price. I understand prices.
Exactly! You think like a businessman.
You see? That is the vision! Premium vision!
Credit? My guy, credit died last week. We buried it.
I can't. Hajiya Ladi will read my book and sigh.
I'm not broke. I'm pre-rich.
Sapa is not a phase. It is a lecturer. It takes attendance.
Customer is king. King must also pay.
This is not a power bank, my guy. This is a lifestyle.
My network is premium. It disappears premiumly.
You need data? Torch? Kola? Ask me. I know a guy.
You ate? Don't lie. I can see sapa on your face.
How much do you have? I'm asking for your own good.
PROFIT! Small, but it's wearing a suit!
Trust the Plug. Did I not say? I said.
Loss. Small loss. A learning expense.
We lost. Write it as 'marketing'.
Ah! Careful! These goods are premium. So am I.
You hit me? That's a service. I'll invoice you.
I'm fine! The stock is fine? The stock is fine. Good.
Na ground I check. [I was inspecting the ground.] Quality floor.
Light don go! Torches! Premium torches! Three hundred!
NEPA is my best salesman. Never takes a salary.
Up NEPA! Charge your phone at the Plug! Fifty naira!
Light is back. Torch sales are over. Pity.
Rain! Umbrellas! Nylon bags! I have both!
Rain is God's way of advertising umbrellas.
Sun is hot! Cold zobo, cold pure water! For you, specially!
This heat is a business opportunity wearing a disguise.
Shawarma? Who's paying? You? Then yes.
Suya with pepper. The only premium thing I don't sell.
My bum bag has coins. The coins have dreams.
Money is like network. You see it, then you don't.
For me? Thank you. I will not resell it. Today.
Is this premium? It is premium. I can feel it.
Thank you. I know a guy who will love this.
Hm. Receipt dey? [Is there a receipt?] Joking. Mostly.
A receipt book! With carbon copies! You understand me!
For my sisters? You remembered? …Don't make me emotional.
Refund? In this economy?
Who is this Hajiya Ladi? She looks at my book like a lecturer.
You carried that stock in record time. You're staff now. Unpaid.
The Plug! A locker, a padlock and a vision!
It's a FLAGSHIP locker.
Turbo Sneakers. Wear these. Run. You'll understand.
The SUG porter comes at two. We close at one fifty-nine.
I don't sell products. I sell advantages.
Lucky Kola for the road? For you, specially, half.
I'm writing it in the book. The book is a napkin. Still.
Night stock count. Seven kolas, one hope.
Night customers pay double. It's a fear premium.
The gown fit you. And a friend. Value for money.
Your change? I still have your number. That's worth more.
The wind took your gown. Premium aerodynamics.
Hajiya said I have customers, not a business. She's wrong. Small.
I gave away the torches. All of them. I'm still recovering.
I SURVIVED YEAR 1 shirts! Pre-order! Before it ends!
My share and your share. Both are… resting.
Refunds are being processed. By Hajiya. Slowly.
THE PLUG S-T-O-R-E. The sign goes downwards. It's distinctive.
The mall has receipts. We have VOLUME.
Power banks by the carton! Very cheap! I know a guy!
Printed price tags. Air conditioning. God when?
Power banks are slightly warm. That's how you know they're fresh.
KB prices by face. I price by friendship.
Two hundred customers. One stall. Zero chairs.
Counting stock. The power banks are humming. Is that normal?
Market closed. Mall still blazing. I'm studying the enemy.
The supplier tried to sell to me. I sold to him first.
Nusaiba says the back of the contract is blank. It's minimalist.
Ghost Hoodie. Free. If anybody asks, you don't know me.
MIDNIGHT FLASH SALE! Every guard came! Two bought!
Six kekes on my credit. I wrote 'charity'. It hurt my pen.
I'm not running. I was relocating. Briefly.
The power banks were two terms of fees. Two terms.
You came to the motor park. At midnight. Thank you, my guy.
Hajiya lent me the refunds. Hard price. Fair price.
Strike money: garri in, coins out. Coins go to the debt.
Garri again? It's not hunger. It's brand loyalty.
You bought a Combo you didn't need. I saw. Thank you.
Sapa Combo! Garri, groundnut, sugar! One hundred naira!
Sapa Combo: because you have considered the alternatives.
A mobile retail platform. Some call it a wheelbarrow.
Still in debt. But the debt is now organised.
Strike economy. Everybody is a customer. Nobody has money.
Mama Nkechi gave me her pot. I'm keeping it forever.
Measured cups. Too much, I lose. Too little, they leave.
Wheelbarrow parked. Ledger open. Small profit. Real profit.
Night shift at the hostels. Garri is a midnight product.
First honest number in my book. Hajiya said. Can I frame it?
I sold the locks. For the halls. I never asked what for.
Oxblood. Leather sole. A heel that knocks. I'll never forget.
I gave HIM a discount. HIM.
Write my name where it belongs. I sold them. I'm fixing it.
Mama Nkechi won the cooking contest. I lost. Deliciously.
Plug Store 2.0. Two branches. Real receipts.
Returns policy. I read it every morning. Like a hostage.
Receipts! With my logo! Spelled correctly!
I hired a cashier. Now I watch the cashier. Business.
Two branches. One me. I need a twin. I know a guy.
Nusaiba's posters. At cost. Then free. Pain.
Hajiya Ladi said nothing about my book. I'm framing the silence.
Inventory at midnight. Everything matches. I'm scared.
Black Friday prep. Price stickers in my dreams.
Premium access! I took only thirty percent. You're the product.
Free posters for Nusaiba. Wallahi, it pained me.
I said 'refund'. Out loud. Then I sat down.
The silence. She had nothing to correct.
Time-Freeze Watch. Free. It's a sample. Don't look at me.
Black Friday at the Plug! Both branches! Queues!
Yes. With a receipt. Everything has a receipt now.
Three freshers on staff. Uniforms. And lunch.
Customer is king. Staff must also eat.
Finalist with a business. My sisters are coming to convocation.
Freshers think I was always rich. I was pre-rich.
Five million. I looked at it for a long time. Then I said no.
Third branch? Don't tempt me. Tempt me small.
Last year. The Plug will outlive my matric number.
Closing up. Three freshers sweeping. I'm almost a boss.
Real meat. It was a negotiating tactic. It worked on me.
Commercial since I was nine. Emotional for one lunch.
I said no to Megawatt. My hands are still shaking.
Free boosts all night! Don't tell my accountant!
Chief in silk pyjamas. Premium. I'm still jealous.
My sisters were in the crowd. They waved at me. Me.
You were my first customer. Now look at you. Look at me.
The Plug: three branches, one founder, zero refunds denied.
I paid my sisters' fees. All of them. Early.
Megawatt calls me 'young man'. I call him 'competitor'.
My first investor! Your share is finally worth something!
{{PLAYER_NAME}}! Graduate! For you, specially: everything half price.
Hajiya's loan is paid. With interest. She smiled. Once.
The Sapa Combo is still on the menu. For tradition.
Go well. If you need anything, I know a guy. Me.
Freshers! Gowns! Buckets! Mattresses! Welcome to the Plug!
Fresher discount! It's the same price, but with a smile.
Gown rental for matric. Sizes: big and bigger.
Brain Booster Tea! Exam special! Pass or… pass!
Exam week. Torches, biros, prayer. I sell two of those.
Results! Celebration shawarma or consolation shawarma. Same price.
My results? Let's say I'm diversified.
Allowance day! Come and spend responsibly. At the Plug.
Bank queue? I sell pure water to the queue. Captive market.
Market day. Hajiya's row. I have a stall in the big people's row.
Thursday. Best prices. Best pickpockets. Hold your bag.
Strike? Students stay, students eat. Sapa Combo is back.
No lectures. Business has no strike.
Cup final! Face paint! Whistles! Vuvuzelas! Lucky socks!
Groundnut bets accepted. The house always wins.
Election posters printed. Any candidate. I'm neutral. Commercially.
Every candidate promises light. I sell torches. Both of us win.
Convocation! Gowns, frames, flowers! Photographs by my guy!
One day I'll wear the gown. Mine will fit. I'll check.
Ramadan Kareem. Dates at cost this month. No profit. Wallahi.
Iftar packs for the mosque grounds. I'm donating ten. Quietly.
Barka da Sallah! [Happy Sallah!] Sallah outfits! Premium!
Merry Christmas! Bus tickets home, I know a guy.
Christmas lights! For your room! Batteries extra!
Valentine's! Roses, chocolates, cards! Love is premium!
Singles' garri party special. Garri for one. Dignity included.
Harmattan! Vaseline! Lip balm! Body cream! Shea butter!
Dust season. Sunglasses indoors finally make sense.
